title: Implement header parser (=ybegin, =ypart, =yend)
description:
Implement src/header.rs: parse the three yEnc header/trailer lines.

All three lines have the same key=value structure. The parser must:
- Split on ASCII whitespace to find key=value tokens
- For =ybegin: name= MUST be last (its value is the remainder of the line after the key); all other fields are whitespace-delimited
- Accept fields in any order
- Skip unknown fields (do not Err on unrecognized keys)
- Accept both LF and CRLF line endings (strip \r before parsing)
- Field names are always lowercase; do not bother with case-insensitive matching

Internal types (not public, used by decode/encode):
  struct BeginHeader { line_length: u8, size: u64, name: String, part: Option<u32>, total: Option<u32> }
  struct PartHeader { begin: u64, end: u64 }  -- 1-based offsets
  struct EndHeader { size: u64, part: Option<u32>, pcrc32: Option<u32>, crc32: Option<u32> }

Parse functions (private):
  fn parse_begin(line: &[u8]) -> Result<BeginHeader, YencError>
  fn parse_part(line: &[u8]) -> Result<PartHeader, YencError>
  fn parse_end(line: &[u8]) -> Result<EndHeader, YencError>

Parsing =ybegin name= field: find the b'n','a','m','e','=' sequence, then take everything after it to the end of the line (after stripping \r\n). This handles filenames with spaces correctly.

Required fields for each line:
- =ybegin: line=, size=, name= are required; missing any -> InvalidHeader
- =ypart: begin= and end= are required
- =yend: size= is required; crc/part fields are optional

Tests (all oracles are hand-computed or from the yEnc spec, NOT from this parser):
- =ybegin line=128 size=189463 name=CatOnKeyboard.jpg -> correct struct
- =ybegin part=1 total=3 line=128 size=500000 name=My File With Spaces.rar -> filename='My File With Spaces.rar'
- =ybegin with unknown field (e.g. foo=bar) -> Ok, unknown field ignored
- =ybegin missing size= -> Err(InvalidHeader)
- =ypart begin=1 end=26624 -> correct struct (1-based)
- =yend size=26624 part=1 pcrc32=ae052b48 crc32=ff00ff00 -> correct struct, hex parsed correctly
- CRLF line ending on all three line types
close_reason: Implemented in header.rs: parse_ybegin, parse_ypart, parse_yend. Handles all required fields, unknown fields silently skipped, field order independent. 10 tests.
